Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.description: The terms for using Excellence AI. The service is an invitation-only enterprise workspace, not a public consumer chatbot.

Home.badge: Enterprise MCP server · Operated in the EU
Home.heroBody: Excellence AI is an enterprise MCP server: the secure, standard connection between AI tools and company systems. Your team keeps its familiar tools; you control access, approvals, and the audit trail.
Home.featureMcpBody: No new chatbot to roll out. Your team keeps working in the AI tools they know, while Excellence AI connects them securely to company systems.
Home.featureAccessBody: You decide who can access each company system. Sensitive actions only run after a human approves them.
Home.featureAuditBody: Every AI action is logged: who asked for it, which data was accessed, and what happened. Everything can be reviewed later.
Home.featureAdminBody: Company administrators manage AI agents, system connections, roles, and autonomy. Only approved capabilities are available.
Home.featureModelsBody: Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Grok — your team uses what works. Company governance always stays in Excellence AI.
Home.howStep1Body: Who can use each AI tool and company system, and which actions require human approval.
Home.howStep2Title: The team connects its AI tools
Home.howStep2Body: One secure company MCP address. Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible client — the same connection.
Home.howStep3Title: A human decides at the sensitive points
Home.howStep3Body: File writes, folder creation, outbound actions: an approval card, one click.
Home.aboutBody: Excellence AI connects your team's AI tools to company systems. The company manages access, approvals, and audit in one place, while employees keep working in the tools they already know.
Home.aboutCardLead: <brand>Excellence AI</brand> is an enterprise MCP server operated by Excellence Pay Kft. It gives any MCP-compatible AI governed access to company systems — with a full audit trail, privacy safeguards, and human approval.
Home.aboutCardRest: The service is a closed, invitation-only enterprise workspace, not a public chatbot. External account connections are always optional; see the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms</terms> for details.
